title: Booking a coast walk
instructions: 原创模拟情境，非官方试题；这是独立分科短测，不是40题完整试卷。开始前不看正文、原音、词表或答案。先独立完成8题并保存原始答案，提交后再核对依据。难度是编写目标，尚未经真实考生标定。
transcript:
Guide: Coast Walks, this is Rachel.
Owen: I would like to book two places for the walk on Sunday. I saw that it starts at the beach café.
Guide: We have changed the meeting point. The café is being painted, so please meet at the bus shelter opposite it. The start time is still eight thirty.
Owen: Is it a difficult walk?
Guide: The whole route is six kilometres. The first part is flat, but there are steps near the lighthouse. We stop for a short rest at the top. Allow three hours, including the break.
Owen: What do we need to bring?
Guide: Water and a hat. There is very little shade. Wear shoes with a good grip. We do not recommend sandals. I can lend you a rain jacket if the weather changes.
Owen: How much is it?
Guide: Eighteen dollars per adult. That includes a bus ticket back to the starting point. You can pay me on the day. Please send your mobile number by email today so I can contact you if the walk is cancelled.
Owen: Does light rain mean it is cancelled?
Guide: No, but we cancel for thunderstorms. We never take a group onto the exposed path when there is lightning.

questions.prompt: What is the new meeting point?
options: The bus shelter opposite the café
answers: The bus shelter opposite the café
questions.evidence: please meet at the bus shelter opposite it.
questions.explanation: it 指前文咖啡馆，集合点在其对面公交候车亭。

questions.prompt: What time does the walk start? Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS.

questions.prompt: How long is the whole route in kilometres? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: The whole route is six kilometres.
questions.explanation: 三小时是含休息的时间，不是距离。

questions.evidence: there are steps near the lighthouse.
questions.explanation: 开头路段平坦，灯塔附近有台阶。

questions.prompt: Why does the guide advise bringing a hat?
options: All walkers must wear a uniform.
questions.explanation: 帽子应对少树荫；雨衣另可借。

questions.prompt: What is included in the adult price?
questions.evidence: That includes a bus ticket back to the starting point.
questions.explanation: 费用包括回起点的巴士，不含其他物品。

questions.evidence: Please send your mobile number by email today
questions.explanation: 留下手机号码供取消时联系，不要求提前付款。
小雨不会自动取消，雷暴才会。
